title: Vampire-Inspired Lace Chemise with Winged Cape | Black | Halloween Intimates
description:
Most Halloween chemises are short, sheer, and warm to wear. This one is longline, fully lined through the body, and comes with a detachable cape that fastens at the shoulders.

It was built for October rather than for a costume party in a warm room — the fabric has enough weight to sit against a slight chill, and the cape is long enough to matter in a photo.

The chemise straps are convertible: worn as shoulder straps, or crossed at the back as a crisscross, which changes the neckline enough to work under a suit or a blazer if you want to wear it out for dinner.

WHAT MAKES IT WORK
• Longline cut with a full body lining — coverage without bulk
• Detachable winged cape, fastens at the shoulders
• Convertible straps: straight or crisscross at the back
• Fabric weight chosen for an actual cold night out
• Long enough to layer under a coat or blazer

DETAILS
• Material: 80% Viscose, 20% Lace with polyester lining
• Color: Black
• Closure: Convertible straps; concealed hook closure
• Pattern: Floral lace
• Origin: Made in China
• Care: Hand wash cold. Line dry. Do not bleach.

FIT & SIZING
The chemise is cut to skim rather than cling, so the waist has extra room. Size down for a closer fit.
Model is 5'10" (178 cm) with a 36" bust, wearing size S.

SIZING (body measurements)
Size | Bust | Underbust | Waist | Hip | Weight (lb) | Equivalent to
XS | 30–31 in | 26–27 in | 23–24 in | 33–34 in | 90–115 lb | US 0–2
S | 32–33 in | 28–29 in | 25–26 in | 35–36 in | 115–140 lb | US 4–6
M | 34–35 in | 30–31 in | 27–28 in | 37–38 in | 140–165 lb | US 8–10
L | 36–38 in | 32–34 in | 29–31 in | 39–41 in | 165–190 lb | US 12–14
XL | 39–41 in | 35–37 in | 32–34 in | 42–44 in | 190–215 lb | US 16–18

Sizing tips:
• Measure your underbust — the band directly under the bust, snug but not tight. This matters more than the bust measurement for anything with a bodysuit fit.
• Measure your hip at the widest point, roughly 8 inches below the waist. This is the number most people underestimate.
• If you are between sizes, size up for sleepwear and lounge pieces, and size down for fitted bodysuits where you want a close fit.
• Fabric stretch varies by style. Each product page lists how much give the fabric has — styles listed as "about 2 inches of stretch" will size down more easily.
• Between a standard size and an extended size? Take the standard size. The jump to extended sizing changes torso length and gusset volume, not just the measurements.

QUESTIONS WE GET A LOT
Q: Does the cape come off?
A: Yes. It fastens at the shoulders with small hooks and detaches, so the chemise can be worn on its own.

Q: Is the chemise see-through?
A: The body of the chemise is fully lined. The lace overlay is semi-sheer as lace always is, but nothing shows through underneath it.

Q: Can I wear this out to dinner, not just to a party?
A: That was the point of the design. The weight, lining, and length are meant for going out, and the convertible straps change the neckline enough to work under a blazer.

Q: How long is the cape?
A: The cape falls to mid-calf. It is long enough to read clearly in a photograph but not so long that it drags on the ground.
